title: Resource Pressure Rollout Hardening and Integration Testing
intent: Verify mixed-version resource-pressure safety across evaluator, admission, monitor, and repository stale-write behavior before rollout.
observed_inputs: Old worker advertisements may omit telemetry and pressure fields.
Telemetry collectors can omit unavailable host, Docker, GPU, or thermal signals.
Relay delivery can reorder worker advertisements by event arrival time.
